title: Reliability and Validity of a New Device Measuring Spinal Rotation on the Transverse Plane
brief_summary: The purpose of this research is to investigate the reliability and validity of a new device similar to a scoliometer. The intended name of the device will be Scolioscope
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria: lumbar and thoracic scoliosis -

Exclusion Criteria: recent spinal surgery, cancer, spinal fixation

\-
study_population: Anyone with thoracic and/or lumbar scoliosis
